part.text:
Fixed. The Node.js HTTP adapter in lib/adapters/http.js:428 hardcoded `'timeout of Xms exceeded'`, ignoring `config.timeoutErrorMessage` (unlike the XHR adapter). The fix:

```js
var timeoutErrorMessage = config.timeoutErrorMessage || ('timeout of ' + timeout + 'ms exceeded');
```

Validation:
- `should respect the timeoutErrorMessage property` (test/unit/adapters/http.js:125) now passes — it was failing before the change.
- Full unit suite: 65 passing, 2 failing — both failures (`maxContentLength`, HTTPS) are pre-existing on the unmodified baseline (which had 3 failing) and unrelated to this fix.
